local weaktable = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

---GetInstances
---@param cls UIWindowBase
---@return table<UIWindowBase, any>
local function GetInstances(cls)
    if not cls then return weaktable end
    local s_instances = rawget(cls, "s_instances")
    if not s_instances then
        s_instances = {}
        rawset(cls, "s_instances", s_instances)
    end
    return s_instances
end

---recordWindowInstance
---@param win UIWindowBase
local function recordWindowInstance(win)
    local instances = GetInstances(win.class)
    instances[win] = 1
end

---removeWindowInstance
---@param win UIWindowBase
local function removeWindowInstance(win)
    local instances = GetInstances(win.class)
    instances[win] = nil
end

---GetInstance static function
---please call with cls:GetInstance()
---@return UIWindowBase
function UIWindowBase:GetInstance()
    local instances = GetInstances(self)
    return next(instances)
end

---GetAllInstances static function
---please call with cls:GetAllInstances()
---@return UIWindowBase[]
function UIWindowBase:GetAllInstances()
    local instances = GetInstances(self)
    return table.keys(instances)
end

---@protected
function UIWindowBase:OnDispose()
    self:OffAllClick()
    removeWindowInstance(self)
    self:StopDelayCloseTimer()
    self:OnDestroy()
    --self.contentPane:Dispose()
    --self.contentPane = nil
end

-- 增加对象 target 的 onClick 事件监听，当 obj 为空时，默认为 self
---OnClick
---@param target FairyGUI.GButton
---@param memFunc function
---@param obj table
function UIWindowBase:OnClick(target, memFunc, obj, ...)
    obj = obj or self
    local args = {...}
    local function handler()
        memFunc(obj, unpack(args))
    end
    target.onClick:Add(handler)
    self._clickHandlers = self._clickHandlers or {} -- lazy init
    table.insert(self._clickHandlers, {
        target = target,
        obj     = obj,
        memFunc = memFunc,
        handler = handler,
    })
end

-- 非有需求不需要特意调用此方法
-- 取消对象 target 的 onClick 事件监听，当 memFunc 为空时，移除 OnClick 增加的所有监听
---OffClick
---@param target FairyGUI.GButton
---@param memFunc function
---@param obj table
function UIWindowBase:OffClick(target, memFunc, obj)
    local list = self._clickHandlers
    if list and #list > 0 then
        obj = obj or self
        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            local info = list[i]
            if info.target == target and (not memFunc or (memFunc == info.memFunc and obj == info.obj)) then
                target.onClick:Remove(info.handler)
                table.remove(list, i)
            end
        end
    end
end

function UIWindowBase:OffAllClick()
    if self._clickHandlers then
        for _, info in ipairs(self._clickHandlers) do
            info.target.onClick:Remove(info.handler)
        end
    end
    self._clickHandlers = false
end

---StopDelayCloseTimer
function UIWindowBase:StopDelayCloseTimer()
    if self.m_delayCloseTimer then
        self.m_delayCloseTimer:Stop()
        self.m_delayCloseTimer = false
    end
end

---DelayHide
---@param delay number
function UIWindowBase:DelayHide(delay)
    self:StopDelayCloseTimer()
    self.m_delayCloseTimer = Timer.New(function ()
        self.m_delayCloseTimer = false
        self:Hide()
    end, delay)
    self.m_delayCloseTimer:Start()
end

return UIWindowBase
